about: What the welcome's last step (Your Windows programs) adds to the App Bridge's list, /usr/share/wildos-appbridge/alternatives.json, which it reads first for names, Store replacements and how each program ran under Windows app support. Entries here match the same way, on lower-case words in the program's name or publisher, and win over that list. mode is windows for programs that need Windows mode, the background Windows tier that runs a real copy of Windows; installer says where a fresh copy of a program's Windows installer comes from, never from the Windows drive: github is a repository whose latest release has an asset matching asset, fetched over HTTPS and checked against the SHA-256 digest GitHub publishes for it.
